$comment: Run configuration (docs/07 §3, docs/04 §5.1). Everything here is identical for baseline and AAE by construction: both read this same file. A field that differs between the two systems is a fairness violation and must be recorded in the report (docs/04 §5).

target.$comment: The target version actually scored is recorded per run as application_commit.

credentials.$comment: MiniCRM is fully synthetic and these are its seeded demo credentials (miniCRM/apps/api/src/seed.ts), which is why they are committed: a judge must be able to reproduce a run. Override with AAE_EMAIL / AAE_PASSWORD, or with config/run.local.json (gitignored), when pointing the harness at anything that is not this sandbox. They are rendered into the shared task prompt (ADR-15) and redacted out of run artifacts by tooling/browser/network.ts.

budgets.$comment: Identical for both systems (ADR-11). maxSteps is enforced by the harness, not by the prompt. maxCostUsd is a per-run safety cap checked by the agent loop (agents/baseline/agent.ts) before every LLM call -- it is a spend guard, not itself part of the frozen fairness contract the way maxSteps/wallClockMs are; edit the number freely.

policy.$comment: docs/07 §2. 'strict' blocks UNKNOWN as the document specifies; 'sandbox' allows and logs it. See the open decision on this in docs/11.

model.$comment: The model must match when comparing workflows rather than models (docs/04 §5). Pinned to gpt-5.6-luna (ADR-22): weaker in absolute VARS than gpt-5.6-sol, ~15× cheaper for the pair, and the architecture's delta holds on both. Recorded into every run's ledger entry. maxTokens is the per-call output ceiling: the whole reconstruction leaves the model as one tool argument (~9k tokens for a full MiniCRM document), and a generation cut off mid-JSON reaches the harness as an unreadable argument, so the ceiling is part of the fairness contract and lives here rather than in a client default (ADR-17).

aae.$comment: AAE-internal architecture, not benchmark input (ADR-11). It subdivides the budget granted in `budgets` and can never raise it. Recorded into every run's meta.json so a run is reproducible from its ledger. The baseline never reads this block.

isolation.$comment: docs/04 §1 mechanical safeguard. Paths that must never appear in the assembled agent context. The public schema under miniCRM/benchmark/schemas/ is not listed: it is benchmark input. Checked by tooling/isolation/context.ts, not by discipline.
